# Inherited Cordis API

Detailed Context, Fiber, Registry, and Service APIs are generated in [context.md](context.md), [fiber.md](fiber.md), [registry.md](registry.md), and [service.md](service.md); the event-dispatch methods in [events.md](events.md).

## Inherited `ctx` members (cordis core + loader/hmr/timer)

- `ctx.on / ctx.once` — Register an event listener (disposable). ([`rsh/Core/vendor/cordis/src/events.ts:34`](../../Core/vendor/cordis/src/events.ts))
- `ctx.emit / ctx.parallel / ctx.serial / ctx.bail / ctx.waterfall` — Dispatch an event (sync / awaited / first-bail / short-circuit chain). ([`rsh/Core/vendor/cordis/src/events.ts:34`](../../Core/vendor/cordis/src/events.ts))
- `ctx.plugin / ctx.inject` — Load a plugin / declare required services. ([`rsh/Core/vendor/cordis/src/registry.ts:164`](../../Core/vendor/cordis/src/registry.ts))
- `ctx.effect` — Register a disposable side effect tied to the fiber. ([`rsh/Core/vendor/cordis/src/fiber.ts:9`](../../Core/vendor/cordis/src/fiber.ts))
- `ctx.get / ctx.set / ctx.provide / ctx.accessor / ctx.mixin` — Low-level service-store access and binding. ([`rsh/Core/vendor/cordis/src/reflect.ts:7`](../../Core/vendor/cordis/src/reflect.ts))
- `ctx.extend / ctx.isolate / ctx.intercept` — Derive a child context (scoped services / isolation / interception). ([`rsh/Core/vendor/cordis/src/context.ts:42`](../../Core/vendor/cordis/src/context.ts))
- `ctx.root / ctx.fiber / ctx.registry / ctx.reflect / ctx.events / ctx.logger` — Ambient handles onto the running context graph. ([`rsh/Core/vendor/cordis/src/context.ts:16`](../../Core/vendor/cordis/src/context.ts))
- `ctx.timer (+ interval / timeout / throttle / debounce)` — Disposable timer helpers. The `timer` key is provided at runtime; the four supported helpers are mixed onto ctx directly (declared via Pick). ([`rsh/Core/vendor/timer/src/index.ts:4`](../../Core/vendor/timer/src/index.ts))
- `ctx.loader` — The config Loader that booted the app (present under the loader). ([`rsh/Core/vendor/loader/src/index.ts:30`](../../Core/vendor/loader/src/index.ts))
- `ctx.hmr` — The hot-module-reload watcher (present under the hmr plugin). ([`rsh/Core/vendor/hmr/src/index.ts:15`](../../Core/vendor/hmr/src/index.ts))

## Inherited events (cordis core + loader/hmr/timer)

- `internal/plugin` — A plugin fiber was created. ([`rsh/Core/vendor/cordis/src/events.ts:328`](../../Core/vendor/cordis/src/events.ts))
